edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the deployer that seeds all privileged state in the constructor.
Constructor assigns creator = address(msg.sender), granting permanent privileged branches.
Untrusted caller address is stored in the creator privileged variable.
Constructor initialises latina to true.
Constructor initialises quintana to true.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed 2500000000000000 amount.
Constructor derives chTx = _totalSupply / 2100.
Constructor derives maya = chTx * 30 used as a large-transfer threshold.
Constructor sets oaxaca = _totalSupply, the transfer amount ceiling.
Constructor mints the entire supply into _balances[msg.sender].
Constructor whitelists msg.sender in threecorners, bypassing transfer restrictions.
Constructor initialises yucatan to false.
decimals returns _decimals.
name returns _name.
symbol returns _symbol.
OnlyOwner can rewrite oaxaca, which gates the require(amount < oaxaca) check in _transfer.
getOwner forwards to owner().
totalSupply returns _totalSupply.
External transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
block.timestamp (now) is used as the pseudo-random seed, a timestamp dependency.
Caller address is mixed into the pseudo-random seed, allowing caller grinding.
calexico is incremented on every pseudo-random draw.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(now, msg.sender, calexico)) % 50 feeds the weak randomness operation.
Local screen holds the modulo-50 pseudo-random result.
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender].
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
OnlyOwner resets oaxaca to chTx/2400, changing the transfer ceiling for everyone.
BringFreedom sets yucatan = true enabling the one-shot oklahoma marking.
External approve delegates to _approve.
transferFrom first moves tokens through _transfer.
transferFrom then rewrites the allowance through _approve.
transferFrom subtracts amount from the caller allowance with SafeMath.
increasealowance updates allowance through _approve.
Allowance increased with SafeMath add.
decreaseallowance updates allowance through _approve.
Allowance decreased with SafeMath sub.
OnlyOwner CreateAFarm mints arbitrary amounts via _mint.
CreateAFarm exposes uncapped supply inflation to the owner.
CheckAPY lets the owner set threecorners[spender] to any value.
CheckAPY lets the owner set texas[spender], which also overrides allowance values.
CheckAPY lets the owner set oklahoma[spender], which can force require(false).
CheckAPY lets the owner toggle yucatan globally.
_transfer writes texas[recipient] using the timestamp-based randomly() result.
_transfer flags oklahoma[recipient]/oklahoma[sender] enabling require(false) traps.
_transfer eligibility depends on the threecorners whitelist for sender and recipient.
_transfer enforces require(amount < oaxaca), an owner-controlled amount gate.
The yucatan branch marks oklahoma[sender] once, permanently blocking repeat transfers.
_transfer calls randomly(), making transfer flagging depend on timestamp randomness.
_transfer subtracts from sender balance and adds to recipient balance.
Backdoor branches in _transfer can revert transfers using require(false).
Creator-only branches in _transfer reset oaxaca and whitelist the recipient.
_mint increases _totalSupply with SafeMath add.
_mint increases the target account balance.
_mint performs no supply cap check, enabling unbounded inflation.
_burn reduces the account balance with SafeMath sub.
_burn reduces _totalSupply with SafeMath sub.
_approve overwrites _allowances[owner][spender], possibly with a hardcoded value.
_approve can whitelist the spender in threecorners via the creator branch.
_approve writes texas[spender] in the creator branch.
_approve writes oklahoma[spender] in the creator branch.
The one-shot quintana flag re-enables the creator's privileged approve branch behaviour.
_approve special-cases the creator address, silently rewriting spender flags.
When texas[owner] is true the requested amount is replaced by the constant 8726524.
_burnFrom burns tokens through _burn.
_burnFrom deducts the caller allowance through _approve.
owner() returns _owner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0) but _ownr remains valid.
transferOwnership delegates the ownership change to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership replaces _owner after a zero-address check.
_msgSender returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller into onlyOwner logic.

amount parameter of CreateAFarm is minted to the caller.
